solutions.19: 48 ÷ 0.6 is greater: dividing by a number less than 1 gives more, multiplying gives less. 48 ÷ 0.6 = 80 and 48 × 0.6 = 28.8.
solutions.20: 7/12 = 0.58333… It does not terminate: 12 = 2² × 3, and the factor 3 makes it repeat.
solutions.24: (a) 24.6 ÷ 0.75 = 32.8, so 32 bottles. (b) 24.6 − 32 × 0.75 = 24.6 − 24 = 0.6 L. (c) 24.6 ÷ 0.6 = 41 bottles exactly, with nothing left. The 0.6 L bottles waste less.

papers.caseStudy: A floor is 5 m by 4 m. It is covered with square tiles of side 25 cm.

solutions.17: Draw a circle of radius 4 cm. Keeping the same opening, step around the circle from any point to mark 6 points. Join them in order.
solutions.18: A small triangle is 1/16 of the square, so the square = 16 × 2 = 32 cm². A large triangle = 4 small triangles = 8 cm².
solutions.19: Make a triangle with sides of 3, 4 and 5 parts. The angle between the 3-part and the 4-part sides is 90°. Place it in the corner.
solutions.20: Construct 60° and 90° at the same point, then bisect the angle between them: 60° + 15° = 75°.
solutions.21: Arc from the vertex cutting both arms; same arc on the new ray; copy the gap between the arm points; join. Measuring shows the two angles are equal.
solutions.22: 4a + 3b = 12 has whole-number solutions only a = 3, b = 0 or a = 0, b = 4. So no mixture of both shapes fits around a point.
solutions.23: (a) Step the 3.5 cm radius around the circle six times and join the points. (b) The two triangles overlap to form a star. (c) Each tip is 60° (the triangles are equilateral); the angle at the centre is 360° ÷ 6 = 60°.
solutions.24: (a) 500 ÷ 25 = 20 and 400 ÷ 25 = 16, so 20 × 16 = 320 tiles. (b) Yes: 25 cm divides 500 cm and 400 cm exactly, and 4 × 90° = 360° at each corner. (c) 6 triangles, because 6 × 60° = 360°.
